scenes.narration_text: Binary search finds a target item in a sorted list by repeatedly dividing the search space in half instead of scanning sequentially.
scenes.visual_description: Sorted array cells with indices and target label

scenes.narration_text: We inspect the middle element, twenty-seven. Since forty-nine is greater, we eliminate the entire left half.
scenes.visual_description: Pointers Low, Mid, High with middle comparison and left half elimination

scenes.narration_text: At the next midpoint, we find forty-nine. With each step cutting possibilities in half, binary search runs in logarithmic time.
scenes.visual_description: Target found highlight and logarithmic time complexity formula
